integrity: The universal statement is proved analytically using a Walsh-Fourier majorant for even-radius Hamming balls. The finite verifier only checks the combinatorial and Fourier identities in bounded dimensions.
scientific_limitations: Only even dilation parameters \(2r\) are determined.
The theorem does not classify all extremizers.
Differently phrased or unindexed literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact even-dilate Shapiro constants for Hamming balls on the Boolean cube
